definition.en: The state of the air at one place over a short time: rain or sun, wind, heat, cloud.
definition.zh: 某个地方短时间内的大气状况：晴或雨、风、冷热、云。

definition.en: The pattern of weather in a place over many years, described with averages and other statistics.
definition.zh: 一个地方许多年的天气规律，用平均值和其他统计来描述。

definition.en: An average for each calendar month over a long period: every January from 1991 to 2020 averaged together, every February, and so on.
definition.zh: 把一段长时期里同一个月份的资料分别求平均：1991–2020 年的所有 1 月一起平均，所有 2 月一起平均，依此类推。

definition.en: A large-scale circulation of the air whose winds change with the seasons.
definition.zh: 随季节转变风向的大范围空气环流。

definition.en: The time between two monsoons, when Singapore's surface winds are light and change direction.
definition.zh: 两段季风之间的时期，这时新加坡的地面风轻而多变。

definition.en: Air moving from the sea towards the land in the daytime, because the land heats up faster than the sea.
definition.zh: 白天陆地比海面热得快，空气从海面吹向陆地，这就是海风。

definition.en: Wind described by two parts together: how fast the air moves east or west, and how fast it moves north or south.
definition.zh: 用两个分量一起描述风：空气向东或向西移动多快，向北或向南移动多快。

definition.en: A reconstruction of past weather made by putting many observations into a computer weather model. The winds here are a coarse regional field from one.
definition.zh: 把大量观测资料放进电脑天气模式，重建过去的大气状况。这里的风是由它得到的较粗的区域风场。

definition.en: A broad, rainy region in the tropics that moves north and south through the year.
definition.zh: 热带里一大片多雨的区域，一年里会南北移动。

definition.en: The change of water vapour back into liquid water when it is cooled. Clouds are made of droplets formed this way.
definition.zh: 水蒸气遇冷变回液态水的过程。云就是由这样形成的小水滴组成的。

definition.en: A very deep cloud that can grow an icy, flat-topped anvil and bring heavy showers, thunder and lightning.
definition.zh: 很深厚的云，顶部可展开成冰质的砧状，带来大阵雨、雷电。

definition.en: Air moving upwards. Updrafts feed a growing storm cloud with warm, moist air.
definition.zh: 向上移动的空气。上升气流把温暖潮湿的空气送进正在长大的雷雨云。

definition.en: An organised line of thunderstorms that forms over Sumatra or the Strait of Malacca and usually moves east.
definition.zh: 在苏门答腊或马六甲海峡上空形成、通常向东移动的一列有组织的雷雨。

definition.en: A strengthening of the Northeast Monsoon winds over the South China Sea that can bring long spells of rain.
definition.zh: 东北季风在南中国海上空增强，可带来长时间的降雨。

definition.en: Smoke from fires, carried by the wind, that can spread across a whole region.
definition.zh: 火灾产生、随风输送、可扩散到整个区域的烟雾。
